logline: 가난한 오두막의 소년 잭이 젖이 마른 소를 팔러 나갔다가 노인에게 콩 다섯 알을 받아 오고, 어머니가 창밖으로 던진 콩이 하룻밤 새 구름까지 닿는 줄기로 자라, 줄기를 오른 잭이 구름 위 거인의 돌집에서 아내의 도움으로 구리 솥에 숨었다가 잠든 거인의 금화 자루를 안고 내려오고, 다시 올라 황금알을 낳는 암탉을 안고 달아난다
destination: 동화 잭과 콩나무에서 만날 수 있습니다
setting: 옛 잉글랜드의 가난한 농가와 시골길, 구름 위의 거인의 돌집
anchor: a slight English boy of twelve with tousled fair hair, a patched dull green waistcoat over an off-white shirt, dull brown trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet, a thin bright face
palette: dull green, off-white, dark brown, dark blue, dull yellow
withheld: 거인이 잭을 쫓아 줄기를 내려오는 대목과, 잭이 줄기를 벤 뒤에 벌어지는 일

beats.beat: 소년 잭이 젖이 마른 소를 팔러 오두막을 나선다

beats.motion: the boy and the cow are the ones who move, and the woman in the doorway holds still: at the start the boy's right hand holds the lead rope taut and the cow's head is low a step behind him; over the first three seconds the boy takes two slow barefoot steps out through the gate toward frame right, the rope staying taut in his hand, and the cow follows him with two slow heavy steps, its head swinging a little from side to side and its thin flanks swelling and sinking with each breath; in the last two seconds both stop well inside the frame on the lane just outside the gate, the boy's face still turned ahead, the cow's head still low; the woman in the doorway keeps her hand on the door post and her face turned after them, her feet not shifting, her apron hanging still; the thatched roof, the small square window, the low stone wall and the bare dark earth of the garden hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift

beats.beat: 길에서 만난 노인이 콩 다섯 알을 내민다

beats.motion: the old man's right hand is the only thing that moves, and the boy and the cow hold still: at the start his open hand with the five pale green beans in it is held out at the height of his waist; over the first two seconds the hand rises slowly to the height of his chest, the beans staying in the open hand, his stooped shoulders not straightening and his left hand staying on the knobbed stick; in the last two seconds the hand holds there, held out toward the boy, the beans still lying in it; the boy keeps his thin face bent toward the hand and his left hand slack on the lead rope, his bare feet not shifting on the dirt; the cow keeps its head turned toward the hedge, its four legs planted, its tail hanging; the hedges, the dirt lane, the dull green fields and the far line of trees hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift

beats.beat: 잭이 소 대신 콩 다섯 알을 쥐고 돌아온다

beats.beat: 이튿날 새벽 마당에 구름까지 닿는 줄기가 솟아 있다

beats.beat: 구름 위 하얀 길 끝에 커다란 돌집이 서 있다

beats.beat: 문을 연 것은 잭보다 몇 배나 큰 거인의 아내다

beats.visual: low firelight inside the vast stone hall: the huge bald man four times the boy's height with the thick black beard and the dull brown coat is the one standing beside the huge wooden table at frame centre, his head lifted and tilted back with his nostrils flared and his heavy brows drawn down, his right hand resting flat on the table top, his left hand hanging in a fist; a round copper pot with its rim as high as the man's knee standing beside the wide hearth at frame left with its lid on; the low fire in the hearth, the flagstone floor, the wooden bench along the near side of the table; he is the only person in the hall; the copper pot stands on the flagstone floor beside the hearth, its rim as high as the man's knee, its lid on, and the top of the huge table is bare wood with nothing on it
beats.motion: the huge bald man is the only one who moves: at the start his head is lifted and tilted back with his nostrils flared and his right hand rests flat on the table top; over the first two seconds his head turns slowly from the table toward the hearth, his nostrils flaring wider as he draws in the air, his heavy brows staying drawn down, his left fist tightening at his side; in the last two seconds his head holds turned toward the hearth and his right hand stays flat on the table, his feet planted; the copper pot beside the hearth stays with its lid on and does not move; the low fire flickers gently; the huge table, the bench, the flagstone floor and the stone walls hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift

beats.beat: 거인이 탁자에서 금화 자루를 세다가 잠든다

beats.motion: the huge bald man asleep at the table is the only one who moves: at the start his bearded cheek rests on his folded arms and his eyes are closed with his mouth open; over the whole five seconds his broad back and shoulders rise and sink slowly with deep sleeping breaths, his open mouth moving very slightly with each breath, his eyes staying closed, his thick fingers lying curled and loose on the table top; nothing else about him moves and he does not lift his head; the three leather sacks, the heap of spilled gold coins and the short stacks of coins stay exactly where they are on the table; the low fire flickers gently; the huge table, the bench, the flagstone floor and the stone walls hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift

beats.beat: 잭이 금화 자루 하나를 안고 줄기를 타고 내려온다

beats.motion: the boy on the stem is the only one who moves: at the start both his hands grip the tendril and his bare feet are braced on the leaf stalk with the leather sack on his back; over the first three seconds he climbs slowly down, his right foot reaching down to the next leaf stalk and then his left, his hands sliding down the stem one after the other, his whole body sinking about one body length down the stem, the sack shifting a little on his back, his face staying turned down; in the last two seconds he holds still on the stem well inside the frame, both hands gripping and both feet braced, his chest swelling and sinking with each breath; the stem, the broad leaves, the curling tendrils, the thin white clouds and the patchwork fields far below hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift
